title: Predecessor single-provider validity rule superseded by the tracked failover delta

ruleConflict.historical: openspec/changes/archive/2026-09-19-nightwatch-current-source-unknown-yield-w12-v1/specs/current-source-yield-measurement/spec.md: first valid provider frozen for the whole wave; later candidates SHALL NOT be probed
ruleConflict.active: openspec/changes/nightwatch-provider-resilient-current-yield-w13-v1/specs/current-source-yield-measurement/spec.md: MODIFIED requirements bind policy-governed deterministic failover; a run stays VALID while the frozen policy is not exhausted and at least one provider returns positive response bytes with positive source activity

resolution: The W13 change delta is tracked and strictly valid (openspec validate --all --strict: 67 passed / 0 failed at activation), so exactly one validity rule is live for this wave; W12's archived artifacts remain immutable predecessor history and are not rewritten. The machine-readable provider-resilience policy and evaluation freeze remain mandatory pre-probe Phase B gates (tasks 11.1-11.4 and 12.1) and are not residuals: they are the implementation of the already-declared rule.
preserved: No admission, reproduction, leakage, or novelty requirement is weakened; the archived W12 spec and task artifacts are unmodified.
